manual_saved_output_review.method: Manual local image plus saved B0/L1 output review; multi-label observations only; not injected into any prompt or training target

observations: Original image visibly has a filled notehead, stem and augmentation dot; B0 calls it a whole note.
B0 output states whole-note4 plus half2 but then calls the result3; internal numerical inconsistency is visible independently of answer matching.
L1 identifies dotted-quarter shape; final answer still incorrect. Correct initial recognition does not establish downstream application correctness.
The image fourth clef is a C-clef symbol, but saved B0 output calls the fourth clef bass in several descriptions.
B0 reaches the accepted final option despite intermediate visual-description errors.
Both outputs use assertions about a preferred clef for minor scales rather than explicitly verifying the pictured note/interval sequence; reasoning validity is not proved by final correctness.
